title: Meta-Union
description: A gem of Minecraft networks. Its community is friendly, helpful, open-minded and mature. The server is also anti pay to win!
body:
You've stumbled across **a gem of Minecraft networks**

We offer the following servers:
- Survival
- Creative

If you want to learn more about each server, read on, otherwise just join ;)

__Survival__
- Towns: If you want to protect your land, you want to either create your own town or join an existing one
- PvP is optional
- Skills: If you like to grind skills, we've got you covered
- Hardcore-esque: No teleportation, no mending, no iron golem drops and the option to turn on Meta-Union's custom hardmode
- High player interaction: A player-driven economy, trading and custom systems which encourage playing together
- Customization: Custom enchantments like higher unbreaking or vein miner, custom items and models
- Built to last: No world resets ever but chunks reset if not claimed or visited within 30 days

__Creative__
- Plots: You start with 1 plot but can technically buy unlimited over time
- Optional collaboration by trusting others in your plot
- Tools like WorldEdit, VoxelSniper, goBrush, goPaint, Arceon, ezEdits and Axiom
- Armor stand editor and thousands of custom heads to bring your build to life!
- Safety: The server has redstone disabled and entities are limited but it's a sacrifice we have to make to ensure people don't crash the server

__Our Community__
Meta-Union's community is probably one of the most friendly and helpful ones you'll ever find, it's open-minded and mature (though silly sometimes but that's part of being mature).
The server is anti pay to win, meaning all you get from donating is a rank that shows in game and nothing else. Donations are only there to support the work put into the server, not to get advantages over others in any way!
